name: Agenția Națională pentru Sport (National Agency for Sport)
verdict: Romania's state sports agency, a public institution set up by government emergency ordinance in 2023. A public body of a state with no sourced record of serious abuses. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: propose 'none'. The link: ANS is a Romanian public institution under the Government (claim ans-romanian-government-ownership, Libertatea + the ordinance text published by the sports trade union). State ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md), and no UN/NGO/court record of the kind METHOD.md counts was found for the Romanian state, so a public owner here rates 'none'. On the shirt: the ANS mark with the Romanian government crest sits on the lower back of Romania's current O'Neills home shirt (official product photo, O'Neills shop, linked from rugbyromania.ro); sport.gov.ro is on the federation's partner bar.
